data.one_liner: Custom sizing system for Flutter widgets to achieve the same physical sizes across different devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides relative sizing methods (sy and sx) based on screen height and width through a RelativeBuilder widget, ensuring widgets maintain consistent physical proportions across various screen sizes.
use_when: You want consistent widget physical sizing across different screen dimensions
Your application is locked to a single orientation (e.g., portrait only)
avoid_when: Your app needs to support both portrait and landscape orientations dynamically
You prefer standard Flutter responsive layout builders and constraints
strengths: Simple custom sizing API via sy and sx scaling methods
RelativeBuilder makes it easy to use in stateless widgets
weaknesses: Does not support orientation changes and can break when rotated
Requires locking device rotation for predictable behavior
